Rachel (Marketing): Quick sync — targeting publish + webinar tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need final changelog permalink, docs anchors for new batching + KV cache flags, and canary timing. Lock links by 3pm PT?
Mike (Eng Release): Draft changelog at https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/rc-1.5-draft — fixing copy now. Will publish stable permalink once merged.
Ashley (DevEx): Please add exact anchor ids; marketing needs them for deep links.
Mike (Eng Release): Done: #adaptive-batching, #kv-cache-prefetch. Example: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/1.5#adaptive-batching
Rachel (Marketing): We prefer canonical stable URL in blog (no redirects). Can release-bot create permalink at publish?
Tom (SRE): We can create a short redirect but prefer canonical stable URL after cut. Ops recommends short redirect only if needed.
Ellie (Ops): Canary plan: 10:00 PT start, 30m hold for telemetry, full ramp 10:30 PT -> 11:00 PT. Rollback window 10:00-10:30.
Hugo (Product): Include benchmark highlights in the post and webinar. Will sales routing doc be ready?
Mike (Eng Release): Adding benchmark summary + link to /benchmarks/1.5-release.pdf. ETA 1:40pm PT.
Ashley (DevEx): QA: confirm public demo endpoint for blog snippet. curl command:
```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/demo/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer PUBLIC_DEMO_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Tom (SRE): Demo endpoint returns 200. Not changing pre-rollout.
Rachel (Marketing): When Mike publishes final, ping release-bot to create stable permalink so I can insert in blog and webinar slides.
deploy-bot: Release candidate created rc-1.5 at https://releases.redwood.ai/rc-1.5
Mike (Eng Release): Final changelog published: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/1.5 — anchors stable.
Rachel (Marketing): Locked. Schedule blog 10:00 PT, webinar 11:00 PT. Marketing will paste canonical changelog + benchmark links in copy. :rocket:
Ellie (Ops): We'll watch metrics 10:00-11:00 and stand by for rollback.
Hugo (Product): I'll send inbound lead routing plan to sales when live. Who owns the one-pager?
Ashley (DevEx): I'll upload the sales one-pager to the drive and DM Hugo.
Rachel (Marketing): Timeline recap: links locked by 3pm PT, final QA 4pm, publish 10am PT tomorrow. Ping here for any slips. :white_check_mark:
